persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Animate this bottle turning slowly in place on the table, just a gentle quarter turn. Keep the camera still. Make it 6 seconds, square, no sound.
bank.Source product: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
bank.Motion: A slow, gentle quarter turn of the bottle in place; rotation direction is your call.
bank.Style and setting: Keep it photorealistic, retaining the wooden table and original surroundings with a stationary camera.

messages.text: Could you animate the bottle in this pic so it turns slowly in place on the table? I've had this little animation in mind for a while and am curious to see it come to life. What I mean is just a gentle quarter turn, with the video being 6 seconds long and square. I always feel like I over-explain these things because I'm worried I haven't described what I'm picturing clearly enough. Please keep the camera still and make it with no sound.
